title: BC28.5 Upgrade: Fixing the OpenTelemetry Error in Invoke-NAVApplicationDatabaseConversion
summary: During a Business Central 25 to 28.5 on-premises upgrade, the Invoke-NAVApplicationDatabaseConversion cmdlet fails with an OpenTelemetry error because PowerShell 5.1 cannot resolve newer .NET dependencies required by OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Http 1.16. Upgrading to PowerShell 7.6.6 or newer resolves the issue.
key_points: Invoke-NAVApplicationDatabaseConversion fails in PowerShell 5.1 with OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Http type initialization exception during BC upgrades
The issue is a regression in BC 28.5 where OpenTelemetry.Instrumentation.Http was upgraded from 1.9 to 1.16, requiring newer .NET dependencies
Binding redirects in Microsoft.Dynamics.Nav.Management.dll.config do not apply in PowerShell 5.1 because .NET Framework only reads the host's .exe.config
The service tier runs fine; only admin cmdlets are affected
Upgrading to PowerShell 7.6.6 or newer resolves the error

quotes.text: .NET Framework only reads the host's .exe.config, so inside powershell.exe or ISE they never apply.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies why binding redirects do not work in PowerShell 5.1 and identifies the technical limitation

quotes.text: Update PowerShell 7 to PowerShell 7.6.6 or newer.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the direct solution to resolve the OpenTelemetry error
